items.name: Answer the Overnight Watch questions
items.line: Six questions, none blocks the start: provider (Twilio), when a quiet session calls you (text at 45 minutes, call at 90), a stand-in for texts while registration is pending, no Twilio package, the build order, and a second key in GitHub secrets. Design: design/overnight-watch.html.

items.name: Answer the Steward's reactions questions
items.line: Four questions, none blocks the start: frustrated without the new hook (milder version, recommended), keep Proud's small confetti, the idle loop default (Calm), and who builds it (Main building after island Phase 2). Try the page: design/showcase.html, section 9.

items.name: Try Visual Review by hand
items.line: Set an App address on a project, run a Claude turn, and look at the card in the panel: the slider, Looks good, Send it back, Later. Dark mode and logins are not checked yet.

items.name: Try the movable panel by hand
items.line: Smoke is hidden now, so you can run the app. Drag the panel by its top bar, close it, open it again (it should pop in where you left it), double-click the bar to put it back. Frost flicker, Reduce Motion, a second screen and the pin are not checked yet.

items.name: Try notch 3b by hand
items.line: Trigger an alert while Steward is in the notch: it should come out under the menu bar, and a click opens the panel.

items.name: Tell us your vision for the website
items.line: Planned for tomorrow, 2026-10-20. The site design and Phase 2 wait for it.

items.name: Idea inbox
items.line: Pick the recommended version or the smaller one. Design: memory/research/2026-10-15-idea-inbox-design.md.

items.name: Review before push
items.line: Pick the recommended version (a review block on the push approval card) or the bigger one (a PreToolUse gate). Design: memory/research/2026-10-15-review-before-push-design.md.

items.name: Start the Overnight Watch phone account
items.line: Make a Twilio account and a US number, then start US text registration (it takes days, and review runs while the first phases are built). Steps, costs and where the keys go: design/overnight-watch.html, section 6. You type the keys into the app yourself, never into a chat.

items.name: Nothing is being built right now
items.line: Notch island Phase 1 is merged. The next builds wait for your go: island Phases 2 to 5 in Main building, Visual Review 1b in Feature building.

items.name: Notch island, Phases 2 to 5
items.line: Phase 1 is merged (PR #34, a4fc04f). Phase 2, being built in Main building now: the note and the settle, chat names (from the transcript's custom-title line) in the note and alerts, and the panel always opening on the left or right edge, never under the notch, with a Panel opens on: Left | Right setting. Then Phase 3 (approval and review sizes), Phase 4 (the rest of the hand-off, quiet mode) and Phase 5 (hardening). Each waits for your go typed into Main building.

items.name: Steward's reactions (designed)
items.line: Steward's face follows the chats: focusing, juggling, a quick nod, all done and proud by turn length, confused, frustrated, welcome back, and a calm random idle loop (yawn, stretch, look around). Three small phases: R1 reactions from what Steward already hears, R2 the idle loop with a Liveliness setting, R3 frustrated with one new hook (PostToolUseFailure, which you add yourself with Settings, Connections, Update). Recommended: Main building after island Phase 2. Brief: docs/briefs/steward-reactions.md. Live: design/showcase.html, section 9.

items.name: Visual Review, Phase 1b: Look closely
items.line: A big before and after viewer (slide, side by side, flip, zoom to the real pixels, keys, the two decisions inside it) and a one-line "Claude says" note on what changed. Design page: design/visual-review-viewer.html. Waits for your go in Feature building.

items.name: Visual Review, Phase 2: the alert
items.line: Tell me: an alert when a Claude turn changed what the page looks like, plus the review history. Overnight Watch uses that history. Waits for your go in Feature building.

items.name: Visual Review, Phases 3 and 4
items.line: Phase 3: highlight what changed, and phone width. Phase 4: a spike on holding the Stop hook, then the opt-in "hold for my review" setting. Recommended after Overnight Watch phase 4 (see below), not before.

items.name: Overnight Watch (designed)
items.line: Go rest, I've got the build: a goodnight card, then Steward watches sessions, deploys and CI while the Mac is awake, calls for urgent things, texts for things waiting on you, and shows a night report in the morning. Five small phases; 1 to 3 need no phone account. Brief: docs/briefs/overnight-watch.md. Design: design/overnight-watch.html. Recommended order: Visual Review 1b and 2, then Overnight Watch 1 to 3, then 4, then Visual Review 3 and 4. Waits for your answers and your go in Feature building.
